findings.value: A charity-run arts venue and cinema in Shoreditch that also hosts gigs, festivals and live events. Its cinema screenings are paused for the next 12 months during renovation, and the cinema is earmarked to reopen in autumn 2027.

evidence.quote: East London’s Rich Mix has paused its cinema screenings for the next 12 months.
While its cinema programme will be on pause, Rich Mix will remain open for gigs and festivals.
The new-look cinema is earmarked for reopening in autumn 2027.

findings.value: Hosts gigs and festivals this autumn, and a season about London's underground culture that mixes music, talks and occasional films.

evidence.quote: The building remains open this autumn, with a busy programme of live events,
a special programme of music, talks and occasional film screenings celebrating the sounds, spaces and communities that have shaped London’s underground culture

notes: Time Out (17 Sept 2026) says only the cinema is paused and the building stays open for gigs, so this is not a closure: no status proposed. The triage 'temporarily-closed' signal should not be applied. richmix.org.uk returned 403 and was not read.
